svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY: an ANSI BBS login screen for a factory floor
svg.desc: A modem dials in and a 1990s ANSI screen draws itself: a big cyan and white ULTRA SATISFACTORY logo beside a hexagon-and-cog emblem, the ident of THE CLOGGED MERGER BBS (sysop Belt Daddy, caller Pioneer #0140, 3 A.M.), and three panels in the app's tab colours. ITEMS is a recipe card drawn as a production line: 3 Reinforced Iron Plate and 12 Iron Rod ride conveyors into an Assembler (60 s, 15 MW) and 2 Modular Frame ride out. OBJECTIVES lists the five Space Elevator phases as a rave line-up. BUILDINGS is the shift roster of nine production machines. Below: a file transfer counting up to 140 items, 211 recipes and 477 buildings, a blinking PRESS ANY KEY, a scroller, and a status bar with the run command and the live URL.
